mapper.select: SELECT r.request_id, r.elderly_id, e.name, r.bed_id, r.phone_number, r.check_in_date, r.check_out_date, r.checkout_reason, r.checkout_type, r.approval_status, r.approval_time, r.approval_person FROM check_out_requests r LEFT JOIN elderly_info e ON r.elderly_id = e.elderly_id;
mapper.update: UPDATE check_out_requests SET approval_status = 2, approval_person = #{approvalPerson}, -- 审批人 approval_time = #{approvalTime} -- 审批时间 WHERE elderly_id = #{elderlyId} -- 根据老人的ID查找退住申请记录 AND approval_status = 1; -- 只更新未审核的记录

UPDATE check_out_requests SET approval_status = 3, approval_person = #{approvalPerson}, -- 撤销审批人 approval_time = #{approvalTime} -- 撤销审批时间 WHERE elderly_id = #{elderlyId} -- 根据老人的ID查找退住申请记录 AND approval_status = 2;
mapper.select: SELECT c.request_id, c.elderly_id, c.bed_id, c.phone_number, c.property_address, c.check_in_date, c.check_out_date, c.checkout_reason, c.checkout_type, c.approval_status, c.approval_time, c.approval_person, e.name, e.age, e.gender FROM check_out_requests c LEFT JOIN elderly_info e ON c.elderly_id = e.elderly_id WHERE (e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') OR #{name} IS NULL) AND (c.bed_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bedId}, '%') OR #{bedId} IS NULL) AND (c.check_in_date = #{checkInDate} OR #{checkInDate} IS NULL) AND (c.check_out_date = #{checkOutDate} OR #{checkOutDate} IS NULL) ORDER BY c.created_at DESC;
